note: Header pictures for casama.ai written pages (round 7), made with codex/gpt-6-luna: no text, no app screens, no mascot. site/build.mjs shows <name>.jpg under the page title with this alt text.

images.alt: A brass weighing scale on a wooden table by a dusk window, a few glowing coins in one pan and a small sprouting plant in the other, beside a warm lamp.
images.prompt: An old brass weighing scale on a wooden table by a window at dusk: one pan holds a few softly glowing coins, the other a small potted sprouting plant; lavender evening light, a warm lamp.

images.alt: An open wooden garden gate under wisteria at dawn, round stepping stones leading through it into a sunlit wildflower meadow.
images.prompt: An open wooden garden gate with no lock at dawn, round stepping stones leading through it into a sunlit wildflower meadow, soft peach and lavender sky.

images.alt: A craft table in soft window light with sewing patterns, felt cut-out shapes, spools of thread, boxes of buttons and a pincushion.
images.prompt: A cozy craft table seen from slightly above with neat stacks of paper patterns, cut-out shapes, spools of thread and small open boxes of buttons, soft lavender light from a window.

images.alt: A forest path at dusk that splits into several trails, each lit by a different softly colored lantern hanging from the trees, with fireflies.
images.prompt: A fork in a forest path at dusk with several trails branching out, each trail lit by a different softly colored hanging lantern, fireflies between the trees.

images.alt: Two small lighthouses on cliffs facing each other across a calm bay at dusk, with a lit cottage on the beach between them.
images.prompt: Two small lighthouses on neighboring cliffs facing each other across a calm bay at dusk, a third little glowing cottage on the beach between them.

images.alt: Paper lanterns of many shapes and soft colors floating over a calm pond at night, reflected in the water between the reeds.
images.prompt: Many paper lanterns of different shapes and soft colors floating over a calm pond at night, reflected in the water, reeds at the edges.

images.alt: Two paths over lavender hills at dusk, one leading to a single walled tower with one gate and the other to an open village of cottages with gardens.
images.prompt: Two paths over rolling lavender hills at dusk: one leads to a single tall walled tower with one gate, the other to an open village of small cottages with lit windows and gardens.

images.alt: A bright greenhouse in the morning with shelves of seedlings in little pots, watering cans on a long shared potting bench and doors open to a garden.
images.prompt: A bright greenhouse in the morning with open wooden shelves of seedlings in little pots, watering cans and a long shared potting bench, doors open to a garden.
